working_definition: Author cell type 'spermatocyte' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult flies), annotated by the authors with FBbt:00004936 'spermatocyte'. Found in: 10x:body (30 cells), 10x:testis (3677 cells), ss2:testis (30 cells).
searches_performed: 'adult spermatocyte' (exact label / exact synonym, FBbt fbbt/releases/2026-10-01)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Male germline cell that is part of the 16-cell spermatocyte cyst. It expresses twine, which regulates the meiotic cycle (Witt et al., 2019).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00004936 'spermatocyte', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
recommendation: Map to the authors' term FBbt:00004936 'spermatocyte', exact match.
